status: follow-up after MB14-MB21; exploratory; new models next to SEL-4L, which is not changed

variants.single: SEL-4L inputs, one token per event (control for the training code)
variants.two_token_id: two tokens per event; history fields only in the previous action token; global player embedding
variants.two_token_anon: two tokens per event; history fields only in the previous action token; anonymous per-window player labels (main)

training.selection: epoch with the lowest validation NLL on scored validation events

evaluation: validation only; each validation event scored once, in the window where it has the most preceding events

reading_rules.same_information: two_token_id is called equivalent to single if its validation NLL is within 0.01 nats of single's
reading_rules.anonymous_cost: the cost of anonymous identity = NLL(two_token_anon) - NLL(two_token_id), reported overall and where in-context identity is available or not
reading_rules.training_code: single is compared with SEL-4L on the same events; a gap > 0.02 nats means this training code is weaker than Track A's and every comparison is made within this book
